home.title: Your remotes
home.empty: No remotes yet. Let's add your TV — it takes 1 minute.

setup.tv_help: Look at the sticker on the back of your TV, or type just the brand, like “LG”.
setup.compatible_yes: Good news! Your {{brand}} TV works with this app.
setup.compatible_no: This TV may not work with Bluetooth.
setup.scanning: Looking for TVs near you… keep the TV ON.
setup.no_devices: No TV found. Move closer and make sure Bluetooth is ON.
setup.name_label: What should we call this remote?

compat.samsung_ok: Samsung TVs from 2018 work over Bluetooth.
compat.samsung_hint: On the TV: Settings → Sound → Sound Output → Bluetooth Speaker List, then tap Connect here.
compat.lg_ok: LG webOS TVs from 2018 work over Bluetooth.
compat.lg_hint: On the TV: Settings → Connections → Bluetooth, then tap Connect here.
compat.sony_ok: Sony Android TVs from 2019 work over Bluetooth.
compat.sony_hint: On the TV: Settings → Remotes & Accessories → Add accessory, then tap Connect here.
compat.philips_ok: Philips Android TVs work over Bluetooth.
compat.philips_hint: On the TV: Settings → Wireless & Networks → Bluetooth → Search, then tap Connect here.
compat.androidtv_ok: Most Android TV / Google TV models work over Bluetooth.
compat.androidtv_hint: On the TV: Settings → Remotes & Accessories → Add accessory, then tap Connect here.
compat.firetv_ok: Fire TV models pair as Bluetooth remotes.
compat.firetv_hint: On the Fire TV: Settings → Controllers → Add new controller, then tap Connect here.
compat.roku_no: Roku sticks use Wi-Fi, not Bluetooth — this app can't control them.
compat.roku_hint: Use the free official Roku app instead.
compat.panasonic_no: Older Panasonic TVs use infrared only — phones can't send that over Bluetooth.
compat.panasonic_hint: This app needs a Bluetooth TV from 2018 or newer.
compat.generic_ok: This looks like it should work. We'll confirm when we connect.
compat.generic_hint: On the TV, open Bluetooth pairing (usually under Settings), then tap Connect here.
compat.unknown: Type your TV brand to check compatibility.
